messages:
alisa: Heads-up — planning promptset for the upcoming FP8/GPTQ/AWQ bakeoff. Need a compact calibration + eval plan that reliably surfaces small accuracy deltas and deployment-specific regressions. Thinking stratified prompt-mix (domain x length x difficulty). Thoughts?

dmitri: +1 on stratification. Quick axes: domain (docs, dialogue, code, math), token-length (<=32, 33-128, 128+), difficulty (anchor/clean vs adversarial/noisy). Add negative controls.

mona: Also include synthetic paraphrases and common typos to probe tokenization brittleness after quant. AWQ and INT8 often diverge on misspellings.

samir: Suggestion: tiny stable anchor set (~200) for gating + expanded probe (~3k) for bakeoff metrics. Anchors must be identical across all model/quant runs.

alisa: Agreed. Anchor=200 (high-stability examples) + probe=3k. Anchor mix: mostly unambiguous QA + some canonical failure modes (ambiguous refs, coref).

dmitri: Sampling pseudocode (deterministic seed) for stratified draws:
```
# pseudo
def stratified_draw(pool, strata, sizes, seed=42):
  set_seed(seed)
  out = []
  for s in strata:
    subset = filter(pool, lambda x: x.stratum == s)
    out += random_sample(subset, sizes[s])
  return out
```

mona: Also label each sample with expected-check type: exact_match, token_threshold, semantic_sim (embedding). For open-gen use embedding cosine >= 0.92 as pass.

eng-ml-bot: Reminder: prior bakeoff showed FP8->INT8 deltas concentrated in code gen. See ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/987

samir: For deployment profiles we should test two buckets:
- latency-sensitive: batch_size=1, max_tokens=256, p95 latency target
- throughput: batch_size up to 64, max_tokens=1024, measure tokens/sec and batching behavior
Evaluate quant variants under both.

alisa: Good — also capture KV cache correctness for long context cases (128+). We should flag token-stream mismatches.

dmitri: Proposed eval metrics: pass_rate, mean_cosine(emb), exact_match_top1, latency_p95, memory_peak. Add a small composite delta score for quick ranking.

mona: Add adversarial slices: math puzzles, obscure unicode tokens, domain jargon. Also create token-shift variants to simulate BPE misalignment after quant (insert/remove spaces).

samir: Example prompt templates and sampling calls (for probe generation):
```
# prompt templates
"Translate: {text}"
"Fix the following code: {snippet}"
"Answer concisely: {question}"

# sampling example (pseudo)
run_eval(model_variant, prompts=probe_list, profile='latency')
```

alisa: Action items: dmitri -> implement sampling harness (stratified random + deterministic seed); mona -> curate anchor 200 and adversarial slices; samir -> build profile runner to execute latency vs throughput. I'll schedule 30m sync Wed.

dmitri: :thumbsup: starting on harness now. will open PR in infra repo with a reproducible pipeline.

mona: I'll hand off anchor set by EOD Tue. Adding 50 dedicated negative controls for hallucination checks.

samir: Q: do we include multiple AWQ configs? per-channel will increase matrix size. Maybe sample 2 AWQ configs + GPTQ baseline + INT8 symmetric.

alisa: Yes sample two AWQ variants (per-tensor / per-channel heuristics) + GPTQ baseline + INT8 symmetric. Keep the matrix small but representative.

eng-ml-bot: Calendar invite created: "Quant promptset sync" Wed 10:30 — https://meet.redwood/xyz

alisa: Thanks all — I'll post the draft sampling spec in #eng-ml later today and tag you."
